longest_examples.instruction: The target car is a grey car parked next to a small green-roofed building in the West Midlands Police Custody Suite building parking lot. The target car is the fourth car from the edge of the parking lot by Holford Drive. To the left of the car is the small green-roofed building which has a size of about one and a half car widths in both dimensions. To the right of the car are two white cars, a black car, then an empty parking stall. Behind the target car is a small square patch of grass. In front of the car is an access lane of the parking lot.

This is a large white car parked in the West Midlands Police Custody Suite building parking lot near the lot's edge adjacent to the footpath named Cross Country: Manchester to Bournemouth (all stations). The car is in the second row of cars from the edge. In front of the car is a small white car. To the left is a black car, an empty parking stall, another black car, then a blue car parked in a perpendicular direction. To the right is a dark blue car and then a grey car. Behind the car is the empty space of the parking lot access lane.

The target car is a dark brown car with a white roof parked in the West Midlands Police Custody Suite building parking lot. The car is in the third row of parked cars from the building, out of a total of four rows. To the left of the car is a red car followed by three blue cars. To the right is a larger grey car with a white roof, a grey car, then a white car, then a blue-grey car, then an empty parking stall. Behind the target car is an access lane of the parking lot.

A light grey car on Aldridge Road is in the middle of crossing an intersection. The car is halfway across the intersection stop line painted on the ground. To the right of the car is a building whose roofs look like a series of staircases. Adjacent to this building, in the opposite direction that the car is travelling in, is the W. D. M. Cars building. Behind the car is a black car, then a red car. The two lanes to the left of the red car has large painted arrows on the ground.
